approvedSentences.imageNotes: Outdoor sunset scene. The sun is setting behind or near mountains on the west side, with warm evening light. The recurring protagonist girl may be shown watching from a safe place. The image must clearly convey "the sun goes down in the west every day" without any text, arrows, compass marks, direction labels, road signs, letters, numbers, zhuyin, or watermarks.

approvedSentences.text: 西邊的天空，滿是粉色雲彩。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 西邊的天空滿是粉色雲彩
approvedSentences.imageNotes: Evening sky scene looking west. The west side of the sky is full of many soft pink clouds, like sunset clouds. A horizon or mountain edge may help show the evening direction, but do not use any written direction labels, arrows, compass marks, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, signs, or watermarks. The focus is the west sky filled with pink clouds.

Outdoor cool-weather scene. Wind blows from one side through trees, and the leaves are turning red. The recurring protagonist girl may be present wearing warmer clothing and looking at the red leaves. The image should suggest a cool west wind and red leaves, but must not use written labels, arrows, direction symbols, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, signs, or watermarks.

approvedSentences.text: 不知道哪些人能跑到最後？
approvedSentences.spokenText: 不知道哪些人能跑到最後
approvedSentences.imageNotes: Safe children's road race or family fun run scene, like a child-friendly marathon. A group of runners are still running toward a visible finish arch or finish line in the distance, but the outcome is not yet known. The image must express "we do not know which people can run to the end" without showing danger, collapse, distress, elimination, readable bib numbers, signs, race labels, text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, or watermarks.

approvedSentences.text: 這些西裝，哪一套最好看？
approvedSentences.spokenText: 這些西裝哪一套最好看
approvedSentences.imageNotes: Use the recurring protagonist father and recurring protagonist girl identities. Father is at home or in a clothing shop trying or comparing several suits. The girl is helping compare which suit looks best. Show several suits with visibly different colors or styles. Do not include price tags, brand labels, mirror text, readable signs, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, or watermarks.
